# Dual Subtitles Plus - YouTube & Netflix

> Dual subtitles for YouTube and Netflix. Translation on top, original below. Customize colors, position, and remember your languages.

Published by Greybrown. Runs on YouTube; on Netflix only after the user turns it on from the popup (“Turn on for Netflix”).
No account, no API key, no server; settings stay in the browser.
Permissions: storage, scripting, activeTab; host access to youtube.com; www.netflix.com is an optional permission, requested only when the user turns Netflix on.
Translation: on YouTube, YouTube's own translation. On Netflix, Netflix's subtitles in the chosen language when available; otherwise Chrome's built-in on-device translator, where the language is supported (39 languages).
Interface languages (11): English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, Turkish, Vietnamese, Arabic.
Not affiliated with YouTube, Google or Netflix.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://greybrownrobin-spec.github.io/yt-dual-subtitles/): what it does, how it works, privacy, questions
- [Dual subtitles extension not working on YouTube — why, and what to use](https://greybrownrobin-spec.github.io/yt-dual-subtitles/dual-subtitles-not-working/): why many dual subtitle extensions stopped working on YouTube, what to check, and what to look for in a replacement
- [Privacy policy](https://greybrownrobin-spec.github.io/yt-dual-subtitles/#privacy): the extension collects nothing
